component.name: Agentry
component.summary: Desktop UI for Claude Code agents

description.p: Agentry is a control panel for the Claude Code CLI: a web UI and multi-agent orchestration around Claude Code, without giving up anything the CLI can do, because it drives the CLI and nothing else.

ul.li: Start and watch conversations, stream the tokens and answer follow-up turns.
Browse every session transcript the CLI has ever written on this machine.
Approve tool calls from the panel as they happen.
Run a graph of agents in parallel with multi-agent orchestration.
Rotate between accounts when one runs out of quota.
